title.zh: 在Calbayog市设立国立职业学校，名称为Tiburcio Tancinco纪念职业学校，并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for the Establishment of a National Vocational School in Calbayog City to be Known as the Tiburcio Tancinco Memorial Vocational School, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Establishment of a National Vocational School in Calbayog City to be Known as the Tiburcio Tancinco Memorial Vocational School, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Dạy nghề Quốc gia tại Thành phố Calbayog với tên gọi Trường Tưởng niệm Dạy nghề Tiburcio Tancinco, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนอาชีวศึกษาแห่งชาติในเมือง Calbayog ในชื่อโรงเรียนอนุสรณ์อาชีวศึกษา Tiburcio Tancinco และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Sekolah Kejuruan Nasional di Kota Calbayog dengan nama Sekolah Memorial Kejuruan Tiburcio Tancinco, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Vokasional Kebangsaan di Bandar Calbayog dengan nama Sekolah Memorial Vokasional Tiburcio Tancinco, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2441_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established, under the supervision of the Director of Public Schools, a national vocations school to be known as the Tiburcio Tancinco Memorial Vocational School. Courses of secondary level shall be offered in the said school.
The Director of Public Schools shall, with the approval of the Secretary of Education, issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.

The sum of one hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, but of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of the said school during the fiscal year nineteen hundred sixty. Such sums as may be needed for the same purpose in subsequent years shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Acts.

This Acts shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
